description: Deterministic policy classifying Job Fit gate assessments and dimension assessments (human_judgment_questions) into automation outcomes: AUTO_PROCEED, AUTO_PROCEED_WITH_GAPS, AUTO_OMIT, AUTO_REJECT, REQUIRE_USER, NOT_APPLICABLE. Consumes Job Fit v1 results already produced by product/semantic_job_fit.py; does not recompute gate status, dimension coverage, or matches. Evidence trustworthiness (placeholder/conflicted exclusion) is decided upstream by semantic_job_fit.py and is trusted as given here. Known Phase-1 contract gap: the current gate_assessments record exposes no field distinguishing profile_evidence_ids that were validated as supporting a PASS/FLAG verdict from profile_evidence_ids that merely survived _supportive_profile_claims while the surrounding proposal was FAIL-without-support, NOT_APPLICABLE, or of unknown status. Until product/semantic_job_fit.py exposes that distinction explicitly (see Phase 2), this policy treats any UNVERIFIED gate carrying non-empty profile_evidence_ids as unvetted rather than supportive, and escalates it to REQUIRE_USER.

reason_codes.gate_flag: Gate proposal raised an explicit caveat requiring human review.
reason_codes.gate_fail_supported: Gate failed with trustworthy, supported disqualifying evidence.
reason_codes.gate_unverified_without_evidence: No affirmative candidate evidence exists for this gate category; omitting the unverified claim is safe.
reason_codes.gate_not_applicable: Gate does not apply to this posting.
reason_codes.gate_unverified_with_unvetted_evidence: Gate evidence is present but the current Job Fit contract cannot confirm it was validated as supporting a proceed verdict; the underlying proposal was not PASS/FLAG-with-support. Escalating rather than assuming support.
reason_codes.dimension_ready: All relevant job requirements/responsibilities for this dimension were matched at or above the required coverage ratio.
reason_codes.dimension_no_relevant_job_ids: This dimension has no job-side requirements or responsibilities to evaluate against; there is no evaluable signal for or against it on this posting.
reason_codes.dimension_partial_coverage: Some relevant job requirements/responsibilities were matched with supported evidence; the remainder are recorded as gaps and must not be claimed as supported.
reason_codes.dimension_zero_coverage: None of the relevant job requirements/responsibilities for this required dimension were matched; this is a material fit question.
